lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct vertical line segments. The cranial-most line is separated from the second line by a wide gap; subsequent lines are spaced with moderate regularity across the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 terminates mid-flank; Line 5 and Line 6 are abbreviated, presenting as vertical dashes that do not reach the ventral fringe or dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping consisting of two primary high-contrast spots on the posterior-lateral haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hindquarters align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature trajectory: horns emerge with a posterior-lateral incline, transition to a medial-anterior inward curve, and terminate with an upward and outward lateral flare.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the combined pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white facial chevron; dual sub-ocular white spots; elongated dark ventral mane/fringe extending from the sub-mandibular region to the lower abdomen.
